verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents proprietary REST APIs (Agent Checkouts, headless checkout, order intents) and a browser-based API reference, and it acts as a client paying x402 and MPP endpoints. None of this shows Crossmint publishing a versioned commerce protocol with a schema and conformance or validation tooling. The OpenAPI probe found no published spec at any candidate path. Interactive API reference pages and consuming third-party protocols are adjacent features, not the capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling
